title: Biome Builder
description: Build actual minecraft biomes, block by block, wherever you want.
body:
![Biome Builder Mod Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d331dade9ece43d0f4958d2dfde560555315b09.png)

**Biome Builder** gives the player the ability to create Minecraft's biomes and structures, wherever they want.

Insipired by Terraria's mechanic of "placing down a number of specific blocks turns the area into a particular biome/structure", the mod adds two types of new blocks: **Biome Anchors** and **Structure Anchors**.

# -Biome Anchors-

![Biome Anchor Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b16c8b440ddf45b07174c6e0cc51c246a548059.png)

## Step One  
To build a biome using the Biome Anchor, simply interact with the biome anchor and select a biome of your choice.

![Biome Category Selection Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7d9eddd6f7078da8bc0e55a94604ecc5ae8e789_0.webp)

![Biome Selection Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2fba821b6b60b05e183731b110ea94ef6de714e2_0.webp)

## Step Two 
Then, fill in the requirements by placing required blocks **within the biome anchor's range:** 

- Vertical Range: **12 blocks** above and below the anchor. (Configurable!)
- Horizontal Range: The **chunk** the biome anchor is placed in, visible by pressing **F3 + G**.

![Biome Requirements Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dda7b38295f2c26c087770f1f51f28179df3f278.png)

![Biome Requirements Fulfilled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6baebab66f11bbab1c460761cf504e3e0dcd162c.png)

## Step Three 
Upon fulfilling the requirements, hit build to convert that chunk into the selected biome.

![Converted Biome Confirmation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a0f8bcc404a3ef9f32b104552e590b90d7014dd.png)

**Be watchful of the requirements: _Some biomes require a minimum/maximum elevation!_**

# -Structure Anchors-

![Structure Anchor Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b30601ab24bd64c30f844c9330f96bcb5a0a5cf2.png)

Structure Anchors function similarly to biome anchors, but they have an additional requirement: 

![Structure Anchors also require Adjacent Biomes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/401d3a6b923e88b5f1cc0f1f5635f508559edb7f.png)

At least **3 directly adjacent chunks (North/East/South/West)** must be a **biome that the structure requires**. If there are more than 2 biomes within a single chunk, it will only detect the biome of the center block (8, X, 8).

An Activated Structure Anchor causes the **chunk** and **24 blocks above & below it** to count as a particular minecraft structure (Vertical Range is Configurable!). Example: Ocean Monuments- the area will spawn Guardians, Nether Fortresses spawn Blazes and Wither Skeletons, etc.

## -IMPORTANT RULES-

- This mod is made with skyblock in mind, but can be used in any world. In the mod is a built-in function for worlds to generate with only one biome, plains (off by default). It is up to the player to find ways to build and restore biomes to their world. (Configurable!)

- Biome and Structure Anchors cannot be within the range of another.

- Certain biomes and structures can become avalible by crafting higher tier anchors. (Configurable!)


## Configuration

- Read [the Config Document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1f-T8rKLgwMNHlm1mF7kDUx8L5PRq1pkKot0iZ3w2nWQ/edit?usp=sharing) for a detailed guide!
